description: Liu, Meiqi and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The configured MoRE model simulates annual PFAS emissions across 526 subcatchments using wastewater plants, industrial discharges, sewers and diffuse pathways. The source-linked TU Wien package contains the SQLite model and setup documentation. Three input variants use median, lower-quartile and upper-quartile concentrations, with different treatments of values below quantification limits. Registered case metadata describes 2015–2021 evaluation and remaining underestimation for some substances. The calculation engine is AGPL, database contents are generally CC-BY-SA, and the separately owned GUI has redistribution restrictions. These component terms are not replaced by the wrapper report licence. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
